messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to cancel my flight because I’m not feeling well. I also purchased insurance when I booked, so I’d like to request a refund, please.

I can help you with your cancellation and refund request. To proceed, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for the flight you wish to cancel. If you don’t know your reservation ID, please provide your user ID and I can help locate it for you.
Sure, my user ID is anya_garcia_5901 and my confirmation number is 3RK2T9.

Thank you for providing your user ID and reservation ID. To confirm, you would like to cancel reservation 3RK2T9 due to health reasons, and you have travel insurance, so you are requesting a refund.

Before I proceed, here are the details of the action:
- Cancel reservation 3RK2T9 for user anya_garcia_5901
- Reason: Health (covered by travel insurance)
- Refund will be processed to your original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days

Do you confirm that you want to proceed with this cancellation and refund? Please reply “yes” to continue.
Yes, I confirm that I want to proceed with the cancellation and refund. Thank you!

Your reservation 3RK2T9 has been cancelled as requested. The refund will be processed to your original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.

However, I noticed that the reservation does not show travel insurance was purchased. If you have documentation showing insurance was included, please let me know or provide it for further review.

If you need any additional assistance, please let me know!
I’m sure I purchased the insurance when I booked the flight. Could you please double-check your records? I definitely added insurance to my reservation.

Thank you for your message. According to the reservation details in our system, travel insurance was not included with your booking for reservation 3RK2T9. 

If you have a receipt or documentation showing that insurance was purchased, please provide it. Otherwise, I recommend contacting our support team with your proof of purchase so they can investigate further.

Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding your reservation or another matter?

I understand what your system says, but I’m absolutely certain I purchased the insurance when I booked this flight. Can you please escalate this or check with someone else? I really need this refund processed through the insurance I paid for.
